Slop Slides · free, in your browser

A free PowerPoint alternative in your browser

Slop Slides covers the everyday deck: themes, layouts, text, shapes, pictures, transitions and a full-screen slideshow, in a browser tab with nothing to install.

Open Slop Slides

How to do it

  1. Open Slop Slides and pick a template or a blank deck.
  2. Add slides, text, shapes and pictures, and choose a theme.
  3. Add transitions and animations, then press Present to rehearse.
  4. Export PowerPoint (.pptx) when you need to share it.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Slides runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Slop Slides made by Microsoft?

No. Slopographic is not affiliated with Microsoft. Microsoft and PowerPoint are trademarks of their owner, named here only to describe what people search for.

Can it open .pptx files?

Yes. Open a .pptx and its slides, text, pictures, shapes and notes come in as an editable deck; anything it cannot keep is listed when it opens. It also exports PowerPoint and PDF.

Do I need an account?

No. Decks are saved to Slop Drive in this browser. There is no sign-up.

What is kept in the PowerPoint export?

Slides, text, shapes and pictures. Transitions, animations, tables, charts and media are not written to the .pptx yet; the app tells you when something is left out.
